dedupe_keys.name: pirmasens hourly building heating demand and rooftop solar thermal potential city energy analyst

description: This dataset gives hourly heating demand and hourly rooftop solar thermal potential for each building in Pirmasens, Germany, simulated with the City Energy Analyst (CEA). It was deposited on figshare on 15 May 2025 by George Avery; the simulations were run by an agent in The World Avatar (TWA) knowledge graph, which also supplied the inputs. Inputs retrieved from TWA were building geometry, weather data and terrain elevation; outputs are per-building hourly heating demand and hourly rooftop solar thermal potential. Coverage: the buildings of Pirmasens. Access: one 641 MB zip on figshare. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; free. Caveats: results are simulated, not metered, and the simulation year and CEA version are not given in the record. Simulation uses: district heating and solar thermal planning, and testing knowledge-graph-driven urban energy digital twins. Related records: the City Energy Analyst model and the Modelblocks European building heat data.
name: Pirmasens hourly building heating demand and rooftop solar thermal potential (City Energy Analyst)
